tasks.title: Finish CMCloud-authoritative Mapping and verified APRS-IS transmission gates
acceptance: CMCloud is the only production authority consumed by CMClient for account/station binding, Mapping revisions, APRS eligibility, ordering, duplicate decisions, producer selection, temporal high-water, and dispatch permits. CMClient never reads CallMesh Mapping/provision data and never uses it as an outage fallback. CallMesh remains the OIDC authority and Legacy compatibility read model; successful token issuance or exchange for an explicitly allowlisted CMCloud OIDC client, including historical issuance backfill, permanently freezes Mapping mutations for that immutable issuer/subject while authenticated CMCloud projection remains permitted. Missing, stale, or ambiguous CMCloud authority fails closed.

Every local APRS write requires a short-lived CMCloud permit bound to the exact tenant, account, station/callsign/SSID, event identity and digest, Mapping revision, sticky freeze epoch, global producer fence, installation and connection generations, authorization generation, monotonic permit sequence, precision_bits of at least 28, trusted event-time/high-water decision, and expiry. Replay, stale revision, 27-bit-or-lower precision, unknown freshness, expired authority, producer ambiguity, or an unconfirmed freeze rejects before socket write.

CMCloud applies a fixed two-second RF preference window. Any valid RF reception for an event permanently excludes Cloud fallback for that event; a selected station becoming unready, disconnecting, or failing submission never changes the producer to Cloud. Only zero valid RF receptions may select the separately authorized BU2GE-15 CMCloud APRS-IS fallback identity. Retries remain bound to the original producer and event.

Trusted source event time, sequence/epoch, canonical digest, and temporal high-water remain internal. CMCloud selects the newest Mapping revision effective at or before source event time, with equality activating the revision; conflicting same-time content without authoritative monotonic order fails closed. Complete valid Mapping history is append-only across refresh/restart, tombstones prevent resurrection, and missing applicable revisions fail closed. APRS receive time never advances source temporal high-water.

The sole public-wire golden oracle remains v0.2.28 tag 5e6c294c640766711c6251173711e8226bf8268a and its frozen formatter/client blobs. Every eligible Tracker event is byte-exact SOURCE>APTMAG,MESHD*,qAO,IGATE:!legacy-data plus CRLF, with fixed APTMAG and no public timestamp or CM2 marker. Golden fixtures retain numeric rounding/carry, symbol precedence, course/speed, sanitation, altitude, UTF-8 and byte-budget behavior. qAO is receive-only; APRS-to-Meshtastic, the removed @cm bot, all other RF transmit paths, and radio configuration mutation remain excluded.

iGate-owned beacon, status, telemetry data, and telemetry definitions use IGATE>APTMAG,TCPIP*:...; CMClient never injects qAC, server-observed qAC is accepted, and status remains >TMAG Client v<version> without CLI/Desktop. Golden fixtures lock beacon PHG/position/symbol/comment/altitude, 512-byte truncation, PARM/UNIT/EQNS/T# bytes and order, message padding, explicit packet types, rolling buckets, verified-session startup order, reconnect, intervals, process reset, and 001..999 sequence semantics.

A bounded CMCloud-permit-scoped persistent APRS session uses incremental banner/logresp parsing and explicit disconnected, connecting, login-sent, verified, and closing states. Every TX/RX session independently exact-verifies the permitted canonical callsign; mismatch, unverified response, timeout, EOF, invalid or oversized response, error, close, half-open connection, permit rotation or expiry, reset, and stale-generation callback fence Data and require fresh verification. The APRS passcode remains installation-local plaintext in ~/.cmclient/secrets.json and never enters CMCloud, CallMesh, browser, sync, logs, diagnostics, or evidence. Per-outbox transient connect/login/write/close transmission is forbidden.

APRS-IS has no per-packet delivery acknowledgement: socket.write is only local-kernel submission. Durable state distinguishes queued, sending, submitted, observer_confirmed, and observation_expired; it never calls a socket write accepted or delivered and advances delivery high-water only after independent filtered observation of exact source, destination, and Info. An unmatched submitted row remains unconfirmed for the persisted three-hour observer window, then expires without blind retry or high-water advance; uncertain writes are never reissued as known-undelivered.

A bounded persisted normalized-source-plus-exact-Info observer cache covers Tracker and iGate-owned families for three hours, and a local transmit cache suppresses exact repeats for 30 seconds across restart/crash, identity, producer-fence, and expiry boundaries. A global tenant plus station/callsign plus SSID fence, not a machine-local lock, prevents Legacy, second-host, stale-process, and delayed-retry overlap; any duplicate-producer evidence blocks authorization without automatic CallMesh unfreeze.

Repository APRS and CMCloud authority docs plus regressions forbid CallMesh consumption by CMClient, local Mapping/provision authority, precision below 28, Cloud fallback after any RF reception, producer switching, APCM20, public CM2 markers, public APRS timestamps, qAR emission, APRS-to-RF, and production APRS endpoint/destination overrides. Tests cover sticky OIDC freeze, compatibility projection without echo loops, permit replay/expiry/revision/fence failures, zero-reception BU2GE-15 fallback, observer reconciliation, and the residual limit that delayed or different Data can escape exact dedup and therefore cannot support a zero-rollback claim.

Postcheck appends attempt_passed or attempt_failed, verifies exact head commit, manifest/candidate binding, origin equality, and ancestry, and only success atomically appends coordinator_completed and marks P18-T10 done.

Classify failure before allocating anything. Network/auth/origin divergence, interrupted reconciliation, and transient lock/file failure append reconciliation_blocked/resumed and reconcile the same task/commit with no ID or commit. A deterministic completion-tool defect uses an even candidateReset=false repair only under the graph-locked non-product/non-package/non-case/non-oracle path allowlist. Any product/runtime/package/case/oracle/evidence-generation or uncertain defect uses an even candidateReset=true repair and reruns affected plus final qualification, including a fresh soak whenever identity or soak validity changed.

For a deterministic repair, append attempt_failed and atomically set P18-T10 blocked/completion_postcheck_failed. The even P18-T20..T98 repair is the sole in_progress task. After its push P18-T10 remains blocked while a fresh odd P18-T21..T99 manifest-attempt task is the sole in_progress task with the declared phase/required/lane/priority/kind/scope/candidateReset/caseGroups fields and dependencies on P18-T09 plus all prior completion repairs/attempts, never P18-T10. After the odd attempt push, mark it done, append repair/attempt dependencies to P18-T10, append attempt_pushed/set head, then return only P18-T10 to in_progress/postcheck_pending. No two tasks are active, no ID/subject/event is reused, and the initial commit remains an ancestor.

The scoped checker proves every required P18 task/assertion at its exact identity level: HWS against the recorded early source, final package/live/recovery/soak against one exact installed candidate, plus 24-hour continuity, repair reruns, full verification, cleanup, origin sync, and secret/raw-data absence.

replaceAcceptance: CMCloud is the only production authority consumed by CMClient for account/station binding, Mapping revisions, APRS eligibility, ordering, duplicate decisions, producer selection, temporal high-water, and dispatch permits. CMClient never reads CallMesh Mapping/provision data and never uses it as an outage fallback. CallMesh remains the OIDC authority and Legacy compatibility read model; successful token issuance or exchange for an explicitly allowlisted CMCloud OIDC client, including historical issuance backfill, permanently freezes Mapping mutations for that immutable issuer/subject while authenticated CMCloud projection remains permitted. Missing, stale, or ambiguous CMCloud authority fails closed.

Every local APRS write requires a short-lived CMCloud permit bound to the exact tenant, account, station/callsign/SSID, event identity and digest, Mapping revision, sticky freeze epoch, global producer fence, installation and connection generations, authorization generation, monotonic permit sequence, precision_bits of at least 28, trusted event-time/high-water decision, and expiry. Replay, stale revision, 27-bit-or-lower precision, unknown freshness, expired authority, producer ambiguity, or an unconfirmed freeze rejects before socket write.

CMCloud applies a fixed two-second RF preference window. Any valid RF reception for an event permanently excludes Cloud fallback for that event; a selected station becoming unready, disconnecting, or failing submission never changes the producer to Cloud. Only zero valid RF receptions may select the separately authorized BU2GE-15 CMCloud APRS-IS fallback identity. Retries remain bound to the original producer and event.

Trusted source event time, sequence/epoch, canonical digest, and temporal high-water remain internal. CMCloud selects the newest Mapping revision effective at or before source event time, with equality activating the revision; conflicting same-time content without authoritative monotonic order fails closed. Complete valid Mapping history is append-only across refresh/restart, tombstones prevent resurrection, and missing applicable revisions fail closed. APRS receive time never advances source temporal high-water.

The sole public-wire golden oracle remains v0.2.28 tag 5e6c294c640766711c6251173711e8226bf8268a and its frozen formatter/client blobs. Every eligible Tracker event is byte-exact SOURCE>APTMAG,MESHD*,qAO,IGATE:!legacy-data plus CRLF, with fixed APTMAG and no public timestamp or CM2 marker. Golden fixtures retain numeric rounding/carry, symbol precedence, course/speed, sanitation, altitude, UTF-8 and byte-budget behavior. qAO is receive-only; APRS-to-Meshtastic, the removed @cm bot, all other RF transmit paths, and radio configuration mutation remain excluded.

iGate-owned beacon, status, telemetry data, and telemetry definitions use IGATE>APTMAG,TCPIP*:...; CMClient never injects qAC, server-observed qAC is accepted, and status remains >TMAG Client v<version> without CLI/Desktop. Golden fixtures lock beacon PHG/position/symbol/comment/altitude, 512-byte truncation, PARM/UNIT/EQNS/T# bytes and order, message padding, explicit packet types, rolling buckets, verified-session startup order, reconnect, intervals, process reset, and 001..999 sequence semantics.

A bounded CMCloud-permit-scoped persistent APRS session uses incremental banner/logresp parsing and explicit disconnected, connecting, login-sent, verified, and closing states. Every TX/RX session independently exact-verifies the permitted canonical callsign; mismatch, unverified response, timeout, EOF, invalid or oversized response, error, close, half-open connection, permit rotation or expiry, reset, and stale-generation callback fence Data and require fresh verification. The APRS passcode remains installation-local plaintext in ~/.cmclient/secrets.json and never enters CMCloud, CallMesh, browser, sync, logs, diagnostics, or evidence. Per-outbox transient connect/login/write/close transmission is forbidden.

APRS-IS has no per-packet delivery acknowledgement: socket.write is only local-kernel submission. Durable state distinguishes queued, sending, submitted, observer_confirmed, and observation_expired; it never calls a socket write accepted or delivered and advances delivery high-water only after independent filtered observation of exact source, destination, and Info. An unmatched submitted row remains unconfirmed for the persisted three-hour observer window, then expires without blind retry or high-water advance; uncertain writes are never reissued as known-undelivered.

A bounded persisted normalized-source-plus-exact-Info observer cache covers Tracker and iGate-owned families for three hours, and a local transmit cache suppresses exact repeats for 30 seconds across restart/crash, identity, producer-fence, and expiry boundaries. A global tenant plus station/callsign plus SSID fence, not a machine-local lock, prevents Legacy, second-host, stale-process, and delayed-retry overlap; any duplicate-producer evidence blocks authorization without automatic CallMesh unfreeze.

Repository APRS and CMCloud authority docs plus regressions forbid CallMesh consumption by CMClient, local Mapping/provision authority, precision below 28, Cloud fallback after any RF reception, producer switching, APCM20, public CM2 markers, public APRS timestamps, qAR emission, APRS-to-RF, and production APRS endpoint/destination overrides.
